sections: SiO2 thin /uniFB01 lm growth through a pure atomic layer deposition technique at room temperature †
Low contamination SiO2 growth under pulsed NH3

figures.caption: Fig. 1 XPS survey spectra of SiO2 thin /uniFB01 lms obtained with a constant /uniFB02 ow of NH3.

Fig. 3 Saturation curves of SiCl4, H2O and NH3 along the SiO2 thin /uniFB01 lm growth. The kinetic growth is shown for 5 cycles with sequential exposure of the surface.

Fig. 4 XPS survey spectra of SiO2 thin /uniFB01 lm obtained with a sequential 90 s exposure of SiCl4, NH3 and H2O precursors. Upper panel corresponds to the signal of the raw /uniFB01 lm and lower panel to the /uniFB01 lm after surface cleaning.
